note: Concession-run (Yellowstone National Park Lodges) full-hookup RV park in lodgepole pine at Fishing Bridge, near where the Yellowstone River leaves Yellowstone Lake; general store and service station nearby. Hard-sided RVs only (no tents, tent trailers or tent-style slideouts) because grizzlies frequent the area; no open fires, charcoal or propane grills allowed. --Claude
